note: Frozen H0 roots. `tools/he1_baseline.py --check` requires the recorded snapshot to equal both values, so re-recording a snapshot cannot silently redefine the baseline. `payload_root` covers the 128 artifact payloads; `definitions_root` covers the sorted definition paths, raw-file digests and canonical digests, which the snapshot's own definition list cannot protect because `--record` rewrites it. Moving either value requires a compatibility ADR; the envelope root is deliberately not anchored because it carries materializer_version.
